spec: §10: "INT as ⌈N/8⌉ little-endian bytes"; "F64 as the 8 IEEE 754 binary64 little-endian bytes"; "QREG and TOKEN as the 8-byte little-endian id"
derivation: INT i9=258 needs two bytes 02 01 (width 9); F64 1.0 is 00 00 00 00 00 00 f0 3f (width 64); QREG/TOKEN id 7 is 07 followed by seven zero bytes (width 64). Counts, measurement bits, tape length and fault order are read by their dedicated result accessors.
